name: light_sleeper
revision: r-cast (2026-11-10): script_vNext.md 'r-cast' adopted (16 lines; Mom's two lines in her own voice; one spoken stress per sentence, in CAPS in `say`); the brand kid narrator (cast `narrator`); one continuous narrator take (narrator_take: one); S01, S03 and S17 dropped; the reveal cuts 1.0 s after the warden's roar
caption: why is my whole village carpeted 😶
logline: A boy in a village where every inch is carpeted, the bell is wrapped in wool and the well wears a wool lid wants everyone to hear one song, so he puts a jukebox on the well.
question: why tf is the whole village covered in carpet?
premise: Every road, stair and doghouse in the boy's village is carpeted, 300 sheep are sheared every morning, the bell is boxed in wool and the well wears a white wool lid. Mom says 'walk soft, the ground's a light sleeper'. Once he pulled the wool off the well and the bottom of the well screamed; Mom said it was a fox. Then a skeleton, shooting at him, hits a creeper, and he gets a music disc in a village where nobody has ever heard a song.
twist: The carpet is silence (vanilla: walking on wool and carpet makes no vibration, and wool blocks stop vibrations). The village sits on an ancient city and the bottom of the well is a sculk shrieker. Tonight he pulls the lid off again because wells echo, puts a jukebox on the well, puts the disc in, and steps off the carpet onto the well's bare stone rim to dance: four shrieks, the Darkness pulsing ('like a real party'), and the warden rises out of the square. He was obliterated by a sonically-charged shriek.

voice.model_hint: the cast locks each speaker's model: narrator gemini-3.8-flash-lite-tts; Mom per voices/cast.json

N.on_screen: pov (the hand, never his face); Milo as a kid; seen from outside only small and from behind (S07, S12's crane start, S13's shoulder, S16), default Steve skin (owner: the hero stays Steve)

Mom.on_screen: villager, plains farmer (straw hat), no name tag

lines.text: My VILLAGE / is COVERED in / nine thousand CARPETS.
lines.say: My village is covered in nine thousand CARPETS.

lines.text: The road? CARPET. / The stairs? CARPET. / The DOGHOUSE? / Also CARPET.
lines.say: The road? CARPET. The stairs? CARPET. The DOGHOUSE? Also CARPET.

lines.text: Even the BELL / wears a SWEATER.
lines.say: Even the bell wears a SWEATER.

lines.text: Walk SOFT, sweetie. / The GROUND'S / a light SLEEPER.
lines.say: Walk SOFT, sweetie. The ground's a light SLEEPER.
lines.direction: warm and gentle, reminding her kid of the house rule like she's said it a hundred times

lines.text: But ONE time, / I PULLED / the WOOL / off the WELL.
lines.say: But one time, I pulled the wool off the WELL.

lines.text: Then SOMETHING / down the WELL / just SCREAMED.
lines.say: Then something down the well just SCREAMED.

lines.text: Mom SAID it / was a FOX. / I didn't KNOW / FOXES lived / in WELLS.
lines.say: Mom said it was a FOX. I didn't know foxes lived in WELLS.

lines.text: Then I FOUND / a music DISC / by the FARM.
lines.say: Then I found a music disc by the FARM.

lines.text: A real SONG. / Nobody HERE / has HEARD one.
lines.say: A real SONG. Nobody here has HEARD one.

lines.text: So TONIGHT, / I PUT / a JUKEBOX / on the WELL. / Wells ECHO, / you KNOW.
lines.say: So tonight, I put a jukebox on the WELL. Wells echo, you KNOW.

lines.text: The FOX / screamed AGAIN. / It LOVED / the MUSIC.
lines.say: The fox screamed AGAIN. It loved the MUSIC.

lines.text: Then the LIGHTS / went DARK. / Just LIKE / a PARTY.
lines.say: Then the lights went DARK. Just like a PARTY.

lines.direction: suddenly scared but keeping it gentle; quick and low, not whispering

lines.text: But I'd NEVER / danced BEFORE. / So I STEPPED / off the CARPET / onto the STONE.
lines.say: But I'd never DANCED before. So I stepped off the carpet onto the STONE.

ending.loop: cause and effect: the shriek is why L01's village is covered in nine thousand carpets
